result.summary: CHANGELOG.md gains a Fixed entry for ISS-0180/#511 covering the C3 wrong-database mechanism, why migrate's exit 0 made it silent, the C1 second instance (hardcoded r-co-db_test-1 falling through to a substring filter matching any workspace), the new C0 preflight, before/after evidence in both directions, and explicit proof nothing was weakened (C4 untouched, C3's precondition stricter). Entry also records that this closes a trio of gate-integrity fixes with #498 (masked failure) and #497 (misattributed failure). ISS-0180.json resolution/prevention rewritten to give the C1 instance equal standing and to state the two structural lessons. Requirement mapping checked, not assumed: search of docs/requirements.yaml for test-env/schema_migrations/migration-ledger terms returns only product-level per-schema tracking semantics (TNT-01, ISS-504), which concern how migrations are tracked, not the developer health checklist that inspects them. No requirement maps to tools/verify_test_env.py, so no status was moved and reqctl.py set-status was correctly not run.
